puzzles.description: The DevOps Agent lined up deployments against the errors. Select the 2 lines that show what changed right before checkout broke.

config.prompt: Select the 2 lines that show what changed just before checkout broke

lines.text: 20:40:11 INFO  deploy  checkout-api v4.1.3 rollout complete (healthy)
21:12:37 INFO  deploy  payment-service v2.8.1 rollout complete (healthy)
21:47:02 INFO  deploy  checkout-api v4.2.0 "flash-sale-banner" by temp-hotfix-admin
21:48:15 ERROR checkout-api payment call timed out after 300 ms
21:48:15 WARN  client  retry immediately (no backoff) attempt 2/5

hints: 💬 Datin Sarah: "Don't tell me what's broken. Tell me what changed."
🤖 DevOps Agent: "Errors start at 21:48. Look at the deployment just before, and at what it changed."
🤖 DevOps Agent: "The v4.2.0 deploy line and the PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS diff line."

puzzles.description: The DevOps Agent wrote up its findings. Sort fact from fiction.

statements.text: The agent found the cause by lining up the deployment, the config change and the error graph.
The CPU alarm on recommendation-service is what broke checkout.
Clients retrying instantly with no backoff turned a small spike into a retry storm.
The right fix is to make clients retry faster.

hints: 💬 Datin Sarah: "Which of these would you repeat to the board?"
🤖 DevOps Agent: "The CPU alarm isn't on the payment path. And faster retries add load, they don't remove it."
🤖 DevOps Agent: "TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE."

puzzles.description: The DevOps Agent drafted a rollback plan and needs your approval. Type the version to restore.

config.prompt:
$ devops-agent plan --service checkout-api
current:      v4.2.0   (5xx 38%)
last healthy: see the 20:40 deploy
recommended:  rollback
$ approve rollback checkout-api --to _
falseOutputs: That version isn't the last healthy build. Check the deployment log.
Look for the checkout-api deploy marked healthy before 21:47.
It's the checkout-api version deployed at 20:40.

hints: 💬 Datin Sarah: "Put it back the way it was when it worked."
🤖 DevOps Agent: "The last healthy checkout-api build went out at 20:40."
🤖 DevOps Agent: "4.1.3"

puzzles.description: Tonight needs four different defences. Connect each one to its job.

sockets.label: Pen-tests and reviews code before launch

hints: 💬 Datin Sarah: "Who was supposed to catch this, and when?"
🤖 Security Agent: "I work before launch. GuardDuty watches at runtime. WAF sits in front of the login page."
🤖 Security Agent: "Security Agent→before launch, GuardDuty→runtime threats, WAF→bots, Secrets Manager→credentials."

puzzles.description: The bots are the noise. Find the real breach.

steps.narration: The botnet is loud, and WAF is already throttling it. Underneath, one key is in use from an unknown IP.
steps.question: Which pre-launch finding became tonight's breach?
options: Finding 3: the waived hard-coded admin key
None. The botnet was impossible to predict
steps.after: ✓ Finding 3. The Security Agent caught it three weeks ago. The team shipped past it, and the release that broke checkout was pushed with that same key.

steps.narration: The key is revoked and the role deleted. Now make sure it can't happen again.
steps.question: Which guardrail stops this before the next launch?
options: Block one country at the WAF
Block merges while a critical finding is open
Lock every account after one failed login
Run a pen test once a year
steps.after: ✓ A critical finding blocks the merge. Waiving it under deadline pressure is how tonight started.

hints: 💬 Datin Sarah: "Forget the loud part. What did we already know about?"
🤖 Security Agent: "Two findings were fixed. One was waived as temporary."
🤖 Security Agent: "Finding 3, then block merges while a critical finding is open."

puzzles.description: Every line on the bill traces back to something you saw tonight. Connect each cost to its cause.

sockets.label: Debug logging left on in v4.2.0

hints: 💬 Datin Sarah: "We didn't plan any of this. So who did?"
🤖 FinOps Agent: "I correlated each cost with CloudTrail. The GPUs were launched by temp-hotfix-admin."
🤖 FinOps Agent: "GPUs→leaked key, requests→retry storm, logs→debug logging."

puzzles.description: The FinOps Agent can't switch anything off. It reports, your team acts. Tell them what to shut down first, biggest bleed first.
hints: 💬 Datin Sarah: "What's bleeding us fastest?"
🤖 FinOps Agent: "Sort by ringgit, largest first."
🤖 FinOps Agent: "GPUs, then retries, then logs."

🤖 Agents: "DevOps answered the first, Security the second, FinOps the third."
